sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A herb or small subshrub endemic to Brazil, in humid forest fragments of Minas Gerais and Bahia. It reaches about 40 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The opposite, ovate, toothed leaves are about 3.4–7.2 × 2.1–4 cm. The small white to lilac bilabiate flowers have a 5–6 mm corolla; the capsule is about 3.3 mm long.

sections.title: Family and edibility
sections.text: The species belongs to Solanaceae, not Lamiaceae as an older catalogue description stated. No food use or species-specific toxicity is documented.
